title: Smoothness of a fixed affine model over an affine inverse system
statement: Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category and $D:I\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse diagram [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] all of whose objects are affine. Let $c$ be a limiting cone with point $T$. Let $P,Q$ be affine schemes, let $t:D\to\mathrm{const}(Q)$ be a natural transformation, and let $s:T\to Q$ satisfy $t_j\circ c_j=s$ for every $j$. Let $p:P\to Q$ be locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. If the projection $P\times_Q T\to T$ for the pair $(p,s)$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], then for some $j\in I$ the projection $P\times_Q D_j\to D_j$ for $(p,t_j)$ is smooth. An affine scheme means a scheme isomorphic to the spectrum of a commutative ring.

proof.text: All transition maps between affine schemes are affine. The limit is affine. Global sections of the limit form the filtered colimit of the stage rings, with the structure maps from Gamma(Q) induced by t and s.

Apply global sections to the canonical pullback squares. They become ring pushouts. The affine criteria identify finite presentation of p and smoothness of its limit pullback with finite presentation and smoothness of their global-sections maps.

Apply eventual smoothness of the pushouts of a fixed finitely presented ring map to this colimit and the ring of P. Translate smoothness of the resulting stage ring map back to smoothness of the stage projection.

theorem exists_smooth_stage_of_affine_diagram {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I]
    [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hD : ∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j))
    {Q P : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Q] [IsAffine P]
    (t : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj Q) (s : c.pt ⟶ Q)
    (hs : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ t.app j = s)
    (p : P ⟶ Q) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p]
    [Smooth (pullback.snd p s)] :
    ∃ j, Smooth (pullback.snd p (t.app j))
